findings.statement: The corporate customer segment generates the highest total revenue among all segments.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with JOIN between orders and customers tables, grouped by segment and summed order_value
findings.code:
SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.order_value) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

data_quality_notes: orders table: 0 nulls in any column, 0 duplicate rows
customers table: 0 nulls in any column, 0 duplicate rows
order_value has no nulls but wide range (11.99 to 2118.47)
assumptions: Revenue is calculated as sum of order_value from orders table
Each customer belongs to exactly one segment
limitations: Analysis based on historical order data only
No consideration for future revenue potential or customer lifetime value
